notes: The supplied 'have' was placed on πάντων as the clause's predicate under rules 63 and 75 rather than read off English word order; reading it as a helper on ἡ πίστις remains defensible and the unit's note says so.
Both articles are unrepresented under rule 23: the ASV supplies no determiner for 'unreasonable and evil men' or for 'faith', so ἀπό keeps its own 'from' under rule 21's determinerless clause.
οὐ stands with no negative indefinite, so rules 41 and 59 are not in question and it keeps its own 'not'.
